name: samarth-ai
description: SAMARTH AI monorepo root: tooling scripts only. App dependencies live in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
